hero.title: Your Journey. Step by Step.
hero.subtitle: A simple and guided process to help you access medical treatment in India with confidence.
hero.description: We know that medical travel can seem complicated. Our job is to make the process easier to understand and easier to manage.

overview.title: How the Process Works
overview.description: From your first enquiry to follow-up after treatment, IBN Sina coordinates every important step of your healthcare journey.

steps.title: Start a Conversation
steps.description: Contact our team and tell us about your medical requirement.

steps.title: Share Your Medical Records
steps.description: Send relevant reports, scans, prescriptions, and previous treatment information.

steps.title: Case Review
steps.description: Our team reviews the information you provide and understands your medical requirements.

steps.title: Specialist Coordination
steps.description: We coordinate with an appropriate medical specialist or hospital based on your case.

steps.title: Medical Opinion
steps.description: The specialist reviews your medical information and provides an opinion or recommendation.

steps.title: Treatment Planning
steps.description: You receive information about the proposed treatment, hospital, expected stay, and other relevant details.

steps.title: Prepare for India
steps.description: Once you decide to proceed, we help coordinate the next steps for your medical journey.

steps.title: Arrive in India
steps.description: We assist with the practical aspects of your arrival and hospital visit.

steps.title: Treatment
steps.description: You receive treatment from the healthcare provider you have selected.

steps.title: Follow-Up
steps.description: After treatment, we help coordinate follow-up requirements and communication where needed.

items.title: Clear Guidance
items.description: Understand every stage of your medical journey before you travel.

items.title: Dedicated Coordination
items.description: We coordinate between patients, hospitals, and specialists throughout the process.

items.title: Personalized Support
items.description: Every treatment journey is planned according to your individual medical needs.

items.title: Continuous Assistance
items.description: Support doesn't end after treatment—we remain available for follow-up coordination.

highlight.title: A Complicated Journey Doesn't Have to Feel Complicated.
highlight.description: With experienced coordination and personalized support, we help make your medical travel experience as smooth as possible.

cta.title: Ready to Start Your Healthcare Journey?
cta.description: Share your medical reports with our team, and we'll help you take the next step toward treatment in India.
